about: Public record of baaskaraa: chronology and documents & media. Public facts only (verified against certificates, programmes and press, see the archive record). Works (BK-) and projects (PR-) are published from the archive app into archive.json; this file links to them by number. Documents are DOC-YYYY-NN. b with me
